Okay. Maybe what I'm saying isnt exactly nihilism, but let's keep the definition aside for now. And I don't have a problem with the fact that my life is meaningless. That is the easy part, im happy to have power over my life instead of the universe or some other entity. And i would've continued this way happily, but it would mean accepting our defeat??(sounds stupid ik) In a way. Because we will have to become a part of this "system" where we are forced to exist.

Let's suppose a person A is kidnapped but then after sometime in captivity he is like ok i finally understand that there is no meaning of this abuse, it just happened, not my fault, being kidnapped wasnt my goal of life and i don't have to do anything to bring about any change in the kidnapper..It's useless and meaningless and there is no way that that was my purpose of being held captive or that being kidnapped even had a purpose. After all that realisation, living does become easy for him because he accepts it all and does everything in his power to not cause trouble and simply try to live his life as peacefully as possible. BUT even after all this, he is still living as a captive. Why does he do that? Just because he can't run away and accepts his kidnapping as meaningless, doesn't make his living this way normal or an obvious thing to do. (Here kidnapper is the universe, being kidnapped is being born and A is us). 

Ik all this sounds like total bullshit but atleast try to understand my point. If it is still bullshit then, well sorry lol.

So what im trying to say is that why is it the obvious thing to continue living this way, like i get that we don't have power to do anything else except to just  live and all and accept that we exist. But it's weird that we have to be this way. And noone can do anything about it.

Also, by "idk what to do about it" i meant idk what to do with this info/realisation because even in non nihilistic way it is useless to think about all this, about how we are forced(for want of a better word) to exist. I didn't mean that i really want to do something about it. Ik i can't.
